title: Body: kidney tumour CT, contrast chest CT, more thoracic RT cases
description: Arterial-phase abdominal CT with kidney and kidney-tumour segmentation (C4KC-KiTS, DICOM SEG); an IV-contrast chest CT whose range covers the whole superior mediastinum and thoracic inlet (great-vessel navigation; no reference targets); and two more LCTSC thoracic planning CTs from different institutions with RT organ-at-risk contours, for unseen-patient practice. Four different patients; the KiTS CT is stored RLE-lossless as a decoder fixture.

referenceTargets.label: Kidneys (KiTS SEG)

provenanceDetail.source: tcia:C4KC-KiTS (C4KC KiTS Challenge Kidney Tumor Segmentation Dataset (C4KC-KiTS), doi:10.7937/TCIA.2019.IX49E8NX)
provenanceDetail.method: DICOM SEG (BINARY) read with highdicom; reference series via ReferencedSeriesSequence; frames mapped to source SOP via DerivationImageSequence/SourceImageSequence (58 frame(s)); 0 unmatched, 17 empty frame(s). Masks traced with skimage.measure.find_contours(level 0.5, sub-pixel) and simplified with approximate_polygon(0.25 px); (row, col) converted to image_px [col, row] with (0,0) = centre of first pixel. SEG grid identical to the source image grid. Max SEG-frame to source-slice distance 0.0000 mm. Even-odd holes: 33.
provenanceDetail.note: Segment 1 'Kidney'; SegmentedPropertyType 'Kidney' (SRT T-71000); category 'Anatomical Structure'; SegmentAlgorithmType SEMIAUTOMATIC (Custom); SEG SOPInstanceUID 1.2.276.0.7230010.3.1.4.0.74550.1588583451.436646; ContentCreatorName ''. No pixel overlap with other segments of this SEG.

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Only the segments in this DICOM SEG are referenced (Kidneys, Renal tumour ('Mass')); all other anatomy and findings are unassessed.
referenceTargets.teachingNote: KiTS19 kidney and tumour segmentation (C4KC-KiTS). Per the collection description, segmentations were performed by students under the supervision of an experienced urologic cancer surgeon on the arterial phase; the DICOM SEG records SegmentAlgorithmType SEMIAUTOMATIC. 'Kidney' covers both kidneys; see provenanceDetail.note for whether it overlaps the 'Mass' segment. Pathology is not part of this target.
